title: Privacy Policy
lead: Zero accounts, zero analytics. Your leagues stay on your device.

p: Nothing about how you play. Clipboard GM has no accounts, no sign-in, no analytics, no ads and no trackers.
Buying the full game on clipboardgm.com is the one exception. It happens on Stripe's checkout page, described below.
Your leagues and settings are saved in this device's own storage, by your browser or by the app. They stay there.
A backup is a file you export yourself. Where it goes after that is up to you.
The game's own files, downloaded from the site that hosts it. After that the game runs offline, apart from checks for newer versions of those files.
On clipboardgm.com, a purchase also talks to our server and to Stripe. Now and then an unlocked game asks our server whether its purchase still stands.
Like any web host, the site's host keeps short-lived request logs, IP addresses included. clipboardgm.com and our server run on Cloudflare.
Stripe sells the full game for us as the merchant of record. Stripe collects your payment details, email and billing country, and handles tax and receipts. We never see your card.
Our server asks Stripe whether a checkout was paid, then gives your device a signed unlock code. The code names the checkout, not you. Your device and your backups keep it.
To restore a purchase, our server looks up the email and receipt number you enter at Stripe. It keeps no copy.
Stripe's own privacy policy covers what Stripe does with your details.
None. A few preferences, such as light or dark, and the unlock code are kept in the browser's local storage on your device.
The game collects no personal information from anyone, children included. A purchase is made on Stripe's page, under Stripe's terms.
Delete a league from the main menu or from Settings. Clearing the site's data in your browser, or uninstalling the app, removes everything on the device. A purchase's record stays with Stripe.
If this policy changes, the new text and its date appear on this page.
Open an issue on the project's page.
